name: Cursed Mail
source:
It started with a chain letter.

"This is a cursed e-mail.
If you have received this email, you must forward it to two people you know.
If you don't, you will soon die."

I thought it was a stupid chain letter.  But two weeks later, one of my classmates committed suicide.

He'd ignored the cursed e-mail.

(From the [url=http://homepage2.nifty.com/uyokyokusetsu/source/other/curse/curse.htm]website[/url])
translation:
一切始于一封连锁邮件。

“这是一封受诅咒的邮件。
如果你收到了这封邮件，就必须把它转发给两名认识的人。
否则，你很快就会死去。”

我以为那只是一封愚蠢的连锁邮件。可两周后，我的一名同学自杀了。

他没有理会那封诅咒邮件。

（引自[url=http://homepage2.nifty.com/uyokyokusetsu/source/other/curse/curse.htm]网站[/url]）
